nodes.name: Website AI Webhook
nodes.notes: REQUIRED: select Header Auth credential. Header name X-AllBarka-Webhook-Secret. Keep secret server-side.

parameters.content:
## Website-only server bridge — INACTIVE REVIEW
Keep path: allbarka-web-chat. This is a replacement candidate for the standalone old Web Chat, not a MAIN/order workflow replacement.

1. Webhook: select Header Auth, X-AllBarka-Webhook-Secret = current server-only N8N_AI_WEBHOOK_SECRET (32+ characters).
2. Brain: select existing Groq Header Auth, Authorization = Bearer <Groq key>. No real secret is included here. No paid provider plan is enabled by importing.
3. Website server: N8N_AI_WEBHOOK_URL = this workflow's HTTPS Production URL (/webhook/allbarka-web-chat). Browser continues using /api/chat or /api/concierge/chat. Never expose the secret in frontend/VITE variables.
4. Verify no other published workflow owns the same POST path before publishing one intended receiver. Keep a rollback export.

No DataTable/Sheet prices, local Ollama, WhatsApp sends, order writes, payment verification, private order lookup, Slack ticket creation or permanent PC-memory storage in this branch. It consumes only the authenticated website server's system/catalog/history. Website AI calls use Groq/hosting quotas separately from Meta messages.

Local fixture tests validate graph/Code bodies and actual source bridge compatibility; actual n8n 2.39.6 import, private credentials, HTTPS and live provider are NOT_RUN. Request timeout: 20s; backend deadline: up to 22s. Provider/parse/timeout errors return unavailable, not invented success. Workflow execution payload saving is disabled. Confirm the existing official support number with owner before human-routing launch. See companion verification report.
